newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond issuance up three pct in first half 1997.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond issuance up three pct in first half 1997.

text.p: Municipal bond issuance for the first half of 1997 rose three percent over the same period last year to $92.8 billion, Securities Data Co. said Monday.
Smith Barney Inc, a unit of Travelers Group Inc, was the top-ranked senior manager for the period, underwriting 208 issues totaling $11.4 billion, Securities Data said.
Merrill Lynch & Co was the second-ranked senior manager, with 149 issues and $9.9 billion in deals.
Brown & Wood was the top bond counsel for the half, serving on $6.8 billion of issues, while Public Resources Advisory Group ranked first among financial advisers with $9.8 billion.

In the second quarter alone, long-term municipal issuance rose 11 percent compared to the same period last year, SDC said. June's volume of $21.9 billion, which included a $2.8 billion New Jersey deal, is the largest monthly figure since October 1993.
